title: NIST WebBook: Aspirin is C9H8O4, molecular weight 180.1574 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Aspirin as C9H8O4, molecular weight 180.1574 amu, CAS 50-78-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Aspirin, CAS Registry Number 50-78-2, lists molecular formula C9H8O4 and molecular weight 180.1574 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 180.0422587 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C9H8O4/c1-6(10)13-8-5-3-2-4-7(8)9(11)12/h2-5H,1H3,(H,11,12). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
